name: Fayetteville
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Fayetteville?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes. Golf carts need a city permit and may use authorized streets and recreation paths only, not major or collector streets. The authorized list is not drawn here, so plain golf carts show on tagged cart paths only.

rules.rule: Motorized carts only on authorized streets and recreation paths, not on major or collector streets except approved crossings
Registered LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections

banned_roads.name: Glynn Street and state routes 54, 85, and 92
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts except approved crossings

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Fayetteville?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Glynn Street in Fayetteville?
faq.a: No. Fayetteville keeps carts off major and collector streets except at approved crossings.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV in Fayetteville?
faq.a: Yes, on roads posted 35 mph or less. A plain golf cart still needs an authorized street.
